title: Local complete intersection scheme over its given field
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $Z$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $s:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be its structure morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. The scheme $Z$ is a local complete intersection over $k$ if there exist a family of finite type commutative $k$-algebras $A_i$, each a local complete intersection over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-complete-intersection-over-field], and jointly surjective open immersions $\varphi_i:\operatorname{Spec}A_i\to Z$ [def-weil-open-immersion] such that $s\circ\varphi_i$ is induced by the structural map $k\to A_i$. The empty scheme and an empty chart family are allowed.
